text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"The IAEA describes nuclear power as a low-carbon source.","cited_pids":["7e88e103d8fb#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Higher nuclear output, alongside renewables and coal-to-gas switching, helped level global CO2 emissions in 2019.","cited_pids":["7e88e103d8fb#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Nuclear plants emit no greenhouse gases during operation.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Lifecycle emissions of nuclear power are similar to wind and about one-third of solar.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"In a cost comparison across 16 nuclear countries, cutting CO2 by 1% required about 2.9% more nuclear generation versus about 4.9% more renewables.","cited_pids":["0819b42abe08#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A UK net-zero modelling study concluded new nuclear is cost-effective only under ambitious cost and build-time assumptions.","cited_pids":["f3c7338ed619#1"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"A UK net-zero modelling study found a nearly all-renewable system with storage to be the most cost-effective option.","cited_pids":["f3c7338ed619#1"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Nuclear projects face cost overruns and long construction delays.","cited_pids":["a518156a3214#3","a518156a3214#6"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"The Hinkley Point C project's cost rose from 16 billion pounds to 34 billion pounds.","cited_pids":["a518156a3214#3","a518156a3214#6"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"Nuclear power is a strong low-carbon option whose cost-effectiveness depends heavily on construction performance and alternatives.","cited_pids":[]}]}
